name: Repo Surgeon
description: Apply code edits (patches) to files in the repository. Validates Python syntax (AST) and runs tests automatically to ensure safety.

patches.description: List of patch dicts, each containing 'path' (relative file path) and 'content' (new file content).

path.description: Relative file path from workspace root.

content.description: The new contents of the file.

dry_run.description: If true, only runs syntax checks and writes to sandbox without modifying production files. Default is false.
